# Device Test Online

> Free browser-based hardware diagnostics with local device processing.
> Published by Ellie Petal Media at https://devicetesteronline.com

Core diagnostics run in the browser. Microphone recordings and webcam previews
are processed locally in the page; site traffic measurement (Google Analytics)
and ad delivery (Google AdSense) are disclosed in the privacy policy:
https://devicetesteronline.com/privacy

## Diagnostic tools

- [Hardware Diagnostic Suite](https://devicetesteronline.com/): overview of all tests
- [Mouse Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/mouse-test): clicks, scroll, polling rate
- [Keyboard Tester](https://devicetesteronline.com/keyboard-test): keys, ghosting, NKRO
- [Monitor Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/dead-pixel-test): dead/stuck pixels, display check
- [Microphone Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/microphone-test): record and play back locally
- [Webcam Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/webcam-test): camera feed, resolution, FPS
- [Gamepad Tester](https://devicetesteronline.com/gamepad-test): buttons, sticks, drift
- [Typing Speed Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/typing-test): WPM and accuracy
- [Audio Delay Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/audio-sync-test): headphone/Bluetooth latency
- [Speaker Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/speaker-test): left/right/center output
- [Headphone Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/headphone-test): stereo balance, ear channels
- [Double Click Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/double-click-test): switch bounce detection
- [Refresh Rate Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/refresh-rate-test): browser-visible monitor Hz
- [Touchscreen Test](https://devicetesteronline.com/touchscreen-test): touch points, dead zones
